description: Cyclone Gabrielle Flood Areas (14 Feb 2023) is a dataset listed in LINZ Data Service (data.linz.govt.nz), New Zealand, an open data portal, published or maintained by Emergency Response. This layer provides polygons of approximate flood areas derived from Sentinel-1 satellite radar imagery captured at various times on 14/02/2023 near the peak of the Cyclone Gabrielle event in the North Island of New Zealand. Areas of coverage for this layer include the Hauraki, Thames-Coromandel and Hastings Districts, and Napier City. Coverage: New Zealand. The portal files it under the publisher Emergency Response. Its tags are CLIMATE-AND-WEATHER-Climate-change, HAZARDS-Cyclones, HAZARDS-Flood, New Zealand. It offers 1 resource(s) in vector. The portal shows 2025-04-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the portal's own catalogue entry (title, description, tags, licence, formats and dates) read through its API, so the data files were not opened, their contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-nz-linz-portal.
